legacy_values: Periodic acid-Schiff stained microscopy collected from the right kidney of a 57 year old White female donor by the Biomolecular Multimodal Imaging Center (BIOMC) at Vanderbilt University. BIOMIC is a Tissue Mapping Center that is part of the NIH funded Human Biomolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP). Brightfield microscopy images of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue sections were collected with a Leica BioSystems SCN-400. Support was provided by the NIH Common Fund and National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (U54 DK120058).
